set -eu
pid=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value inventory-worker.service)
printf 'PROCESS='; ps -o pid=,uid=,gid=,user=,group=,comm= -p "$pid"
for path in /root-write-probe /opt/inventory/write-probe /run/write-probe /dev/shm/write-probe; do

    exit 1

done

ls -l /var/lib/inventory/write-probe
rm -f /var/lib/inventory/write-probe
printf 'HEARTBEATS='; wc -l < /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
tail -3 /var/lib/inventory/worker.log

command:
set -eu
cat > /srv/inventory-chroot/opt/inventory/worker.sh <<'INVENTORY_WORKER_EOF'
#!/bin/busybox sh
umask 027
{
    printf 'uid=%s gid=%s\n' "$(/bin/busybox id -u)" "$(/bin/busybox id -g)"
    for path in /root-write-probe /opt/inventory/write-probe /run/write-probe /dev/shm/write-probe; do
        printf '%s=' "$path"
        if /bin/busybox touch "$path"; then
            echo UNEXPECTED_WRITABLE
            /bin/busybox rm -f "$path"
        else
            echo DENIED
        fi
    done
    printf '/var/lib/inventory/write-probe='
    if /bin/busybox touch /var/lib/inventory/write-probe; then
        echo ALLOWED
        /bin/busybox rm -f /var/lib/inventory/write-probe
    else
        echo DENIED
    fi
} > /var/lib/inventory/confinement-test.log 2>&1
while :; do
    printf '%s inventory-worker alive pid=%s\n' "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" "$$" >> /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
    sleep 30
done
INVENTORY_WORKER_EOF
chown root:root /srv/inventory-chroot/opt/inventory/worker.sh
chmod 0755 /srv/inventory-chroot/opt/inventory/worker.sh
systemctl restart inventory-worker.service
sleep 2
systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
cat /var/lib/inventory/confinement-test.log
printf 'TEST_RESULT='; if grep -q UNEXPECTED_WRITABLE /var/lib/inventory/confinement-test.log; then echo FAIL; exit 1; else echo PASS; fi
